lines.zh: 我贴着沙底游，像一片沙。
lines.en: I swim along the sandy bottom like a patch of sand.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，扬起一小片沙。
lines.en: One flick of my tail raises a little sand.
I circle the reef.

lines.zh: 在水里，我比在桶里自在。
lines.en: I'm easier in the water than in a bucket.
I slide over the seagrass.

lines.zh: 冷水里我也不怕，我皮厚。
lines.en: Cold water doesn't bother me. My skin is thick.

lines.zh: 我借着一股暖流，慢慢漂。
lines.en: I ride a warm current and drift slowly.
My fins part the water very lightly.
I swim past a wreck's hatch.
Under the frozen sea there's little light.
I swim slowly and bother no one.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石边缘，不进去。
lines.en: I keep to the reef's edge, not going in.
The pressure pushes me deeper.
I swim into a kelp forest.

lines.zh: 我走的是海底那条老路。
lines.en: I follow the old road along the seabed.

lines.zh: 浮上水面时，我甩了甩尾。
lines.en: At the surface I flick my tail.
I hang in the water, swaying with the swell.

lines.zh: 嘴里含着水，我慢慢过鳃。
lines.en: I hold water in my mouth and pass it through my gills.

lines.zh: 有只小鱼在我旁边，不怕我。
lines.en: A little fish beside me isn't afraid.

lines.zh: 我靠着一块石头，停住了。
lines.en: I settle against a stone and stop.
Sand settles on my back. I don't move.
I'm watching the light above.

lines.zh: 海草碰到我，我让开一点。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes me and I shift aside.
The sand down here is very fine.

lines.zh: 我嚼着海水，尝出你的味道。
lines.en: I chew the seawater and taste you in it.

lines.zh: 远处有鱼群，转成一个圈。
lines.en: A shoal far off turns into a ring.
I'm the color of sand myself.
The water cools and I sink more slowly.
I'm waiting for night to feed.
Waves break on the reef. I can hear it.

lines.zh: 你隔着水看我，我看回去。
lines.en: You look at me through the water; I look back.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我在水里，很好。
lines.en: You're on land, I'm in water. Good.
Do you know this face?

lines.zh: 你伸手进来，我就在那儿。
lines.en: Put your hand in. I'll be right there.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底游，假装没看见。
lines.en: I skim the sandy bottom and pretend not to see.
No nets, please. It's undignified.
My eyes are on the sides of my head.
You've stood so long the water has gone still.
I blow a bubble as a greeting.
You can go. I won't follow.

lines.zh: 在水里翻了个身，沙都扬了。
lines.en: I rolled over in the water and kicked up sand.
Sand grinds into my gills and stings.

lines.zh: 我钻进珊瑚缝，只露尾鳍。
lines.en: I slip into a coral crack, only my tail showing.
I swim on the sand like a patch of it.
I'm swimming crooked.
That knocked a few scales loose.
I press to the bottom and stay still.
Something's knocking on my flank.
I beat my tail and mud the water.
I don't want to stay in this sea now.
Is that fish food?
It hit the surface. I saw it.
I rise and come closer slowly.
Don't scatter it all at once. I can't eat that much.
That smell is familiar.
I hold my mouth open for the next bit.

lines.zh: 你把饵撒下来，沙底都亮了。
lines.en: You scatter bait, and the sandy floor brightens.

lines.zh: 沙子做的鱼，游过去就散一半。
lines.en: A fish of sand; half of me scatters as I swim.
This is for me. I know.
After I eat I'll sink back down.
I bump your hand and slide off.

lines.zh: 我身上全是沙，蹭你一手。
lines.en: I'm covered in sand; you'll get a handful.
My bump sends out a ring of ripples.
I back off and hide in a crevice.
Your boot is in my way.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍拍过你的小腿。
lines.en: My tail fin slaps across your calf.
That one, I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花溅起来。
lines.en: We collide and the water splashes.

lines.zh: 我从你两脚之间滑过去。
lines.en: I slip between your two feet.
Don't step there. I'm in the sand.
The scent of my own kind, ahead.
We swim side by side for a while.
It's smaller than me and paler.
Our tails come together.
The eggs will settle in the sand.
This shallows will feed them.
We don't part. We swim all day.

lines.zh: 两尾沙鱼在海底画了个圈。
lines.en: Two sand fish trace a circle on the seabed.
The weeds will cover the eggs.
This is how days pass in the sea.
I swallow it whole without chewing.
I eat the little things in the sand too.
I hold it in my mouth to test it.
Too hard. I spat it out.
Whatever sinks to the bottom is mine.
I suck it in, sand and all.
That mouthful tasted of kelp.
Two bites and it was gone.
I come around behind it, then eat.
Afterward I flick my tail.
Sand-colored, I vanish on the seabed.
It's darker than the sand.
I stop and watch it.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我游过去就行。
lines.en: From here I just swim over.

lines.zh: 水纹告诉了我它的位置。
lines.en: The ripples tell me where it is.
It hasn't spotted me; the sand hides me.

lines.zh: 我调转鱼头，朝你的影子。
lines.en: I turn my snout toward your shadow.

lines.zh: 这条路上没有别的东西。
lines.en: Nothing else is on this line.
I pick an angle.

lines.zh: 它到了我够得着的地方。
lines.en: It's within reach now.
I follow it without hurrying.
It goes through the reef; I go around.

lines.zh: 我们在石头两边，各走各的。
lines.en: We're on opposite sides of the stone.

lines.zh: 它的鳍一停，我的鳍也停。
lines.en: When its fin stops, mine stops.
I flatten myself to the sand.
It's heading deeper.
I sink after it.
The pressure changes and my ears feel blocked.
It's looked back twice.
On the third, I stop waiting.
I bite down and it thrashes.

lines.zh: 我甩尾扬起沙，迷你的眼。
lines.en: I flick sand into your eyes with my tail.
That bite went wide.

lines.zh: 我用扁嘴把你顶向礁石。
lines.en: I ram you toward the reef with my flat snout.
It bites back and I twist away.
We've stirred the sand past seeing.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，鳃都张开了。
lines.en: I hold on, gills flared.
It fled and I chased a short way.
There's a little red in the water, quickly gone.
I swim back to the bottom and breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I come out of the sand and shake myself.
I don't know this sea.
The water's salt and just the right warmth.
I take one circle first.
The sand below is clean.
Reef, seagrass. Enough.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着别处的沙。
lines.en: I still carry sand from somewhere else.
I open my mouth and taste the water.
There's a shoal in the distance. I see it.

lines.zh: 这条鱼，今天开始归这片海。
lines.en: This fish belongs to this sea as of today.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我只能往深处逃。
lines.en: The water's burning; I flee deeper.

lines.zh: 我从水面掉下来，摔在沙上。
lines.en: I drop out of the air and hit the sand.

lines.zh: 我被捞上来，鳃贴在空气里。
lines.en: I'm hauled out and my gills press on air.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，我被推出去老远。
lines.en: A muffled blast throws me far.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，扎中我。
lines.en: An arrow comes into the water and finds me.
A light chases me through the water.
There's nothing at all in the sand.

lines.zh: 雷光透进浅海，我鳞片发麻。
lines.en: Lightning seeps into the shallows, numbing my scales.
When I sink, I become sand.
